quality.review_scope: Scoped independent source review of all five main pages: postsynthetic conjugates, distinct PS-(CdS)n layer variants, linked specimen results and DNA assay contexts. Core growth cited only; no sample atomic coordinates assigned.
missing_fields: Preformed CdS core preparation is only cited to reference 31. No core growth route, core size, crystal phase or atomic coordinates imported.
Exact physical batch/aliquot links across characterization techniques are unreported.
Assembly temperatures, mixing mode, stock bead concentration, biotin-CdS final concentration, final dispersion volume, centrifuge radius/RCF and wash volumes unreported.
Even-layer wash count and separate PBS-BSA volume unreported. Repetition follows the source instruction; no independent batch identities assigned.
Fig1D acid-dissolution dose/time not given; DNA assay acid dose is not silently assigned to layer comparison.
